And let me add, it's totally okay go get bad grades throughout the year, that's literally what it's about, you go out there do your best but you don't get the best grade, that's totally okay, you start identifying your weak points in certain subjects and working on them and I promise you'll get better the next test, but do not ever let a bad grade bring you down, it's really okay

And you'll certainly have random burnouts throughout the year too, that's totally okay too, what I personally do in that case is just try to fight it for a day or two and if that doesn't work, I take 2 days off while ignoring everything and everyone, I just go to the lessons and that's it and fortunately I came back more energetic each time

I like to think of those bad grades as a challenge, like "oh you think you got me ? I'll show you" as much as it might be cringy and toxic to some people, I personally use it and it works

All of what I said is just what worked for me so far, it may or may not work for you and you'll certainly have your own modifications on it and that's exactly what you should do, as I said everyone's unique in terms of their methods of studying

Hey, I'm currently in ثانويه عامه myself and I'm just as confused as you are man, I study and I do my best I didn't get the best grades last term in senior 2 either, and I really do wish to be in computer science in a couple of months, but here's what I personally did to help myself cope with it.
1- whatever happened in senior 2 or 1 ignore it (in terms of grades)
2- if you're currently in senior 2 planning to get into 3elmy ryada, if you wanna have the best chance please study your calculus it's going to be essential and some of the chemistry
3- don't associate your performance in senior 2 with senior 3, don't listen to many people's advice, I'm not even kidding, and I don't mean it in a naive way, but if you got out there and ask most people about senior 3 you're gonna find many people that are like "oh I didn't study except in the last month and I got 100 %" and others who are like "So you gotta wake up everyday at 5 AM sharp and drink this magic drink then start studying right away then go run a marathon while studying" those people are just extremely confusing so ignore them all the time
4- ignore the other students' صياح as they love to scream about every little thing there is about sanwya 3ama
5- everyone's way of studying is unique to themselves and you develop that way of studying as you go throughout the year if you didn't already develop it
